notes: Sorbent is a carbon molecular sieve hollow fiber made by pyrolysis of P84 co-polyimide in N2 at 1173 K (carbonized polymer, so a carbon sorbent). H2 uptake: one volumetric (Autosorb-1) adsorption/desorption isotherm at 77 K, 0-1000 mbar, in mmol/g (Fig. 6, max about 6.6 mmol/g near 1 bar); no H2 values in text or tables. Surface area: Langmuir s.s.a. about 560 m2/g from the H2 77 K isotherm, and BET/Langmuir 525-625 m2/g from CO2 at 273/298 K (Section 3.3, p. 6); N2 at 77 K gave negligible uptake, so no N2 BET. Research article; record not retracted; no statement that the H2 data were published before.
